stem.en: Match each sentence to the part it describes.

text.en: Without it, the run ends on numbers, not pixels
Without it, the noise just stays noise
Without it, the picture follows nothing you asked for
Changing it gives a new picture from the same prompt
This part repeats a noise guess and a small step, many times
This part gives the numbers that steer each noise guess
This part fills in fine detail from what it learned in training

explanation.en: Words give the numbers that steer, the seed gives the starting noise, the walk removes the noise step by step, and the decoder alone makes pixels.
